newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease as foreign buyers pull out.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease as foreign buyers pull out.

text.p: Slovenia's blue-chip SBI index eased on Monday as foreign investors pulled out in the wake of sharp falls in major world markets, traders said.

"Our market depends on foreign activity a lot and when there is feeling that shares are not worth buying, investors pull out -- not only from New York but also from smaller markets like Slovenia," one broker said.
* The SBI index eased 0.83 percent or 13.26 points to 1,587.14.
* Petrol trader Petrol led decliners, falling 4.18 percent to 25,010 tolars on volume of 2,065 shares.
* Trading firm Kovinotehna was the most actively traded stock, losing 3.28 percent to end at 561 tolars on volume of 9,404 shares.
